title: Uzbekistan’s cement production rises in first six months of 2026
summary: Uzbekistan’s cement production rises in first six months of 2026
body_markdown: **Uzbekistan:** Cement plants in Uzbekistan produced 10.1Mt of cement in the first six months of 2026, according to the National Statistics Committee. Compared with the same period of 2025, cement production increased by 0.2Mt (2%).
